title: Catalyst conversion–selectivity tradeoff across 4 reactor runs
what: In2O3-ZrO2 leads single-pass yield at 68.0% (+12.6 pp over Pd-Ga's 55.4%)

reader_questions.question: Which catalyst achieves the highest single-pass yield and what is it?
How is reactor-run uncertainty displayed?
reader_questions.expected: 4 replicate runs per catalyst (mean ± SD or individual points).

reader_questions.question: Why doesn't Ni-Al2O3 win despite having the highest conversion?
reader_questions.expected: Its selectivity collapses to ~61.5%, cutting yield well below In2O3-ZrO2.
